digest.component_or_area: test isolation / pydantic-ai anthropic provider integration
propositions: Test monkeypatch replacing anthropic.AsyncAnthropic with a function causes TypeError when pydantic_ai.providers.anthropic is lazily imported for the first time, because the provider module evaluates a runtime type union that cannot apply the | operator to a function
The test-isolation defect is order-dependent: the three affected test nodes fail when the provider is not pre-imported but pass when the provider is already in sys.modules
Replacing the function-shaped test doubles with class-shaped doubles that preserve the constructor tripwires restores intended test behavior without pre-importing the provider
A bounded sweep of SDK/provider monkeypatch sites identified three sibling occurrences in test_rp04_s4_llm_runtime_heldout.py that violated the class-preservation contract
